calibration.title: Calibration
calibration.replacesPlate: This replaces what is on the plate.
calibration.changesSettings: The test changes the settings it needs; they show as changed in Settings until you end the test.
calibration.bannerText: on the plate. Slice and print it, then end the test to get your settings back.
calibration.paTowerHint: A tower whose pressure advance rises with height. Measure where the corners look best.
calibration.paLineHint: Lines printed with rising pressure advance. Pick the most even line.
calibration.paPatternHint: Rows of nested corners, each printed with a higher pressure advance. Pick the sharpest corner with no gaps; the number above it is the value.
calibration.temperatureHint: A tower with one block per nozzle temperature. Pick the block that looks best.
calibration.flowRateHint: Blocks printed at different flow ratios. Pick the smoothest top surface and set its ratio in the filament.
calibration.accelerationsHint: Comma separated, like 1000, 3000. One test per speed and acceleration pair. Empty uses the outer wall acceleration.
calibration.speedsHint: Comma separated, like 100, 200. Empty picks the best speed for the test.
calibration.retractionHint: A tower whose retraction length grows with height. Find the lowest length without strings.
calibration.volumetricHint: A vase that prints faster as it grows. Note the height where it starts to fail.
calibration.vfaHint: Vertical fine artifacts: a tower printed at rising speeds. Pick the speed with the cleanest walls.
calibration.shapingFrequencyHint: Sweeps the input shaper frequency on X and Y. Pick where ringing is lowest.
calibration.shapingDampingHint: Sweeps the damping factor at fixed frequencies. Pick where ringing is lowest.
calibration.junctionHint: Sweeps junction deviation up the tower. Pick the highest value with sharp corners.
calibration.frequencies: Frequencies must be 0 ≤ start < end ≤ 500 Hz.
calibration.dampingFactor: The damping factor must be from 0 to below 1.
calibration.frequencyRange: Frequencies must be from 0 to 500 Hz.
calibration.junctionRange: Junction deviation must be 0 ≤ start < end < 1.
calibration.stepPositive: The step must be more than 0.
calibration.temperatureRange: Temperatures must be from 170 to 350 °C, with start at least 5 °C above end.
calibration.paRange: Start PA must be 0 or more, the PA step at least 0.001, and end PA at least one step above start.
calibration.range: Start must be 0 or more, the step above 0, and end at least one step above start.
